race.comment: PHAT CHAPS (7) impressed last start on the quick turnaround, sitting handy and winning by 0.3L. He's an improving commodity and finds a suitable race after scoring as an odds-on pop. Drawn wide, but he's trending the right way and can repeat the dose. CHANTEL (9) led last time out over 1600m at Pinjarra, missing by 1L in a strong performance. On the quick turnaround here, though Riordan's claim means she carries no weight. Last start rating rates highly and she won't be far away. OLAF THE SNOWMAN (6) won well two back before flying home late in the race over 1400m here last time out. Drawn much better here and should be able to sit closer in the run out to the mile. Can put his best foot forward. ROMANTIC RULER (2) has to be included on his recent form. STYLAX (8) can feature again after a surprise win last time out.
